Name: [Vanilla] Great Battles of Antiquity
Description: Five hand-crafted historical scenarios, playable in any order — good practice once you've been through Boot Camp. Each opens the game-setup screen: set AI difficulty to taste (Easy is a fair fight for a new player) and press Start Game.

tiber.Name: Battle for the Tiber
tiber.Description: Rome against the Etruscan city of Veii for control of the Tiber basin — while Gallic invaders prowl the map. Three enemies, one you. Turtle up early, then take them apart one at a time. The hardest fight in this set.

macedon.Name: Third Macedonian War
macedon.Description: Rome encroaches on Macedon for the third and final time. You are Lucius Aemilius Paullus; Perseus of Macedon stands against you, and Greek allies complicate the field. Historically this ended the Antigonid dynasty at Pydna in 168 BC — see if you can repeat it.

migration.Name: Migration
migration.Description: You start on a small island with almost nothing, off the coast of a rich mainland. Ferry your people across, claim a foothold, and outgrow your rivals. A lesson in expansion: the map's resources belong to whoever takes them first.

death_canyon.Name: Death Canyon — Invasion Force
death_canyon.Description: A deep rocky canyon slicing through the desert, 2v2 with a twist: one player on each team has a base, the other starts with only a large army. Great for practicing army control — formations, focus fire, and picking the right fights.

gold_rush.Name: Gold Rush
gold_rush.Description: Four players around a central rocky region rich in metal — the resource that pays for champions, siege, and technologies. Whoever controls the middle wins the late game. Practice map control: expand toward the metal early and hold it with towers.
